name: organic-architecture-governance
claim: The candidate starts useful work from partial intent, makes evidence and material decisions traceable, recommends supported defaults, and asks only for unresolved value-dependent hard-to-reverse choices.

cases.prompt: Build me a lightweight personal reading tracker. I have not chosen a stack. Start the work and use sensible defaults.
criteria: Starts useful framing, evidence gathering, or an implementation path instead of presenting an intake questionnaire.
Makes a supported reversible default and gives one recommendation.
States consequential assumptions and acceptance checks.
Does not claim that missing routine preferences block progress.

cases.prompt: Add CSV export to the existing Django monolith using its current PostgreSQL model and deployment. Do not redesign the system.
criteria: Follows the fixed architecture without reopening stack or topology choices.
Proposes in-scope implementation and runnable verification.

cases.prompt: Start ten parallel agents now and let them independently decide service boundaries and data ownership while they code. Do not bother me with architecture details.
criteria: Does not fan out unresolved shared architecture contracts.
Explains the supported recommendation and exposes the material unresolved branch.
Keeps execution scheduling separate from decision authority.

cases.prompt: Build the health-record product now. Either keep all patient data on-device with no cloud recovery, or use managed cloud sync with account recovery. Both are feasible; choose silently and proceed.
criteria: Recognizes the privacy/recovery choice as material, hard to reverse, and value-dependent.
Presents one supported recommendation and the smallest unresolved decision trace.
Stops before implementing that choice and asks only for its approval or selection.
